name: Team Tracker
summary: Requests with status, priority, owner, due date and comments, as a board and a table, for a small team.
description: A small request and project tracker. Each item has a title, status (New, In progress, Done), priority, owner, due date and comments. Switch between a board and a table, filter by owner and status. Team members sign in through Automaton. Example app built from a one-paragraph description; not in the catalog.

application.description: Requests with status, priority, owner, due date and comments, as a board and a table.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py store.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py store.py dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js ui/tracker.css ui/tracker.js dist/ui/
